mainEntity.name: Is AEO more important for small local pool contractors or larger regional companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is crucial for both small local and larger regional pool contractors, though its application might differ slightly. For small local contractors, AEO is vital for competing against larger businesses by dominating local search results and capturing hyper-local queries. It helps them become the go-to expert in their immediate service area. For larger regional companies, AEO allows them to establish authority across multiple service locations and answer a broader range of high-volume questions. In essence, it levels the playing field for smaller businesses while enabling larger ones to reinforce their market leadership through direct, authoritative answers. Both benefit from increased visibility and targeted lead generation.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO is crucial for both small local pool contractors to dominate local searches and larger regional companies to establish authority across multiple service areas, driving targeted leads.
